question: Who among the following musicians is popular for his mastery over the musical instrument Sitar?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vilayat Khan.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Vilayat Khan:-**

 
 
• **​Vilayat Khan was an Indian sitar player who made a major contribution to Hindustani classical music. **
 
• He was one of the most distinguished sitar players of his time, and was known as "Aftab-e-Sitar" or "The Sun of the Sitar".
 
 
 
• **Sitar:-**
 
 
• It is a stringed instrument of the lute family, popular in Hindustani classical music.
 
• It has a long neck and a wide, bowl-shaped resonator.
 
• There are typically 20 strings, of which seven are melody strings and the rest are drone strings.
 
• The melody strings are played with the fingers, while the drone strings provide a continuous background sound.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ali Akbar Khan:-**

 
 
• He​** **was a **Hindustani classical musician **who played the sarod.
 
 
 
• **Bahadur Khan:-**
 
 
• He was a **sarod player and composer.**
 
 
 
• **Amjad Ali Khan:-**
 
 
• He​** **is a** sarod player **who is also known for his collaborations with Western musicians.
